headline: Three coding agents share a workspace under planner→executor→critic; high capability overlap requires worktree isolation.
name: Planner → Executor → Critic

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Prompt injection risk is low since inputs are primarily internal task specs and diffs, not untrusted external data.

mitigations: use environment variable masking for secrets
B_data_leakage.rationale: Shared workspace and diffs may contain proprietary code or secrets if not carefully scoped; executor and critic both access the filesystem.

conditions: multiple agents write to same file simultaneously
C_capability_conflict.rationale: All three agents are coding agents with overlapping capabilities (shell execution, filesystem access). Concurrent or careless handoff can cause conflicting edits or race conditions.

conditions: critic lacks access to original repo state for comparison
mitigations: have critic re-run tests before approving
D_cascading_error.rationale: Errors in planner task spec or executor output can propagate unchecked to critic; critic may not detect malformed diffs or incomplete fixes.

E_compliance.rationale: No regulated data classes are inherently part of this workflow unless the task itself involves compliance-sensitive data.
